selection_reason: node._compile (potentially attacker-controlled) -> safe hasOwnProperty check -> prevents prototype pollution attacks on CustomNodes
source_summary: CustomNode instances created from user-provided extra_nodes mapping during parsing. The node object comes from parsing user input expressions with custom node handlers.
sink_summary: node._compile(defs, args) call that executes custom compilation logic defined by user-provided CustomNode classes
guard_summary: Added hasOwnProperty check prevents prototype pollution by ensuring _compile method is defined directly on the node instance, not inherited from Object.prototype. This complements the existing typeof check for function type.
risk_pattern: Prototype pollution protection for CustomNode compilation - prevents attacker from polluting Object.prototype with malicious _compile method that would execute when processing any node
context_summary: Security check added to prevent prototype pollution attacks on CustomNode compilation. CustomNodes are created from user-provided handlers during expression parsing and can define custom _compile methods. The check ensures _compile is defined directly on the node instance.
unresolved_facts: Specific attack vectors that could exploit prototype pollution without this check
Whether CustomNode handlers can be provided by untrusted users in this application context

hypotheses.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
hypotheses.fit_reason: hasOwnProperty check prevents prototype pollution attack where attacker could pollute Object.prototype._compile to execute arbitrary code when processing CustomNodes

hypotheses.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
hypotheses.fit_reason: Dynamic method call node._compile() on user-controlled objects requires hasOwnProperty validation to prevent code injection via polluted prototype

hypotheses.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
hypotheses.fit_reason: Prototype pollution protection prevents XSS escalation through polluted Object.prototype methods in expression compilation

hypotheses.cwe_name: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
hypotheses.fit_reason: hasOwnProperty check validates that _compile method exists on instance level before dynamic invocation, preventing unexpected prototype chain behavior
